name: Frustration
description: You lash out at a creature, venting your frustration at your trainer. Make a melee attack roll against a creature, doing {dice} {type} damage on a hit. When you make this attack, add an additional bonus to hit and damage equal to the number of levels you are below zero on the Loyalty Chart. This move bypasses the Loyalty penalty roll, except for uncontrollable creatures based on SR limitations.
